text:
England crush France 82-0 in Rugby League World Cup whitewash to remain in semi-final hunt
England scored 14 tries as they trounced France 82-0 in Perth; landslide win keeps England in contention for a semi-final spot; Herbie Farnworth and Dom Young score hat-tricks while Mikey Lewis comes off bench to bag double; England face Papua New Guinea in final pool match on Friday
By Tony Tighe
Last Updated: 24/10/26 2:30pm
England kept alive their faint hopes of reaching the Rugby League World Cup semi-finals with an 82-0 trouncing of France.
Herbie Farnworth and Dom Young scored hat-tricks as England overcame a nervy start in Perth to boost their scoring difference and remain in the hunt for a last-four spot heading into the final round of pool matches.
England entered the game staring at a 150-point deficit following Samoa's landslide win in Papua New Guinea earlier on Saturday. They took a sizeable chunk out of that with a 14-try victory but require another big win when they face the Kumuls in Wollongong on Friday, and will also need a favour from Tonga against Samoa on November 1.

Mikey Lewis came off the bench to score twice with Matty Ashton, George Williams, Victor Radley, Jez Litten, Jack Welsby and AJ Brimson also crossing for England while Hugo Savala kicked 26 points.
Brimson was the architect for many of those tries, the full-back shredding France in an awesome attacking display, with Junior Nsemba and Kai Pearce-Paul producing a number of eye-catching carries and offloads in contact.
England were met with stiff resistance during the opening quarter as some superb France defending kept them scoreless, but the dam burst on 23 minutes and those early efforts took its toll as they faded badly towards the end of the first half.
Brian McDermott's side scored six tries in the final 17 minutes of the first period, Farnworth grabbing three of those to help England into a 36-0 half-time lead.
The rout continued in the second half and France's persistence with going short from kick-offs led to a hat-trick try for Young on 62 minutes, while Brimson bagged the try his performance deserved with three minutes remaining.
Brimson shines for England
England full-back Brimson was deservedly named man of the match after a brilliant display that included a try, three assists and five line breaks.
He told Premier Sports: "It's my first win for England. Disappointing last week [against Tonga]. We had a tough assignment today, we needed a good performance to give ourselves a chance. It's not always easy having that mindset.
"The first 20 was a grind but credit to our spine and halves, keeping us calm and we knew we'd get them in the end."
McDermott hails 'enormous' effort
England head coach Brian McDermott:
"What we've done today, given the context, is just enormous. We had to win big but, as any coach will tell you, nobody thinks like that. You think, 'we've got to win'.
"We had some real good, candid conversations this week about what that actually means and we've been able to do that without getting distracted in chasing points.
"Everything was measured, everything was inside the game model, everything was what we planned to do - well, most of it at least.
"Whatever the results are next week, we want to finish strong against PNG [Papua New Guinea] as well, and if that means we're going home next Sunday night, that will be a big disappointment to us.
"But I'm not sure what more we could have done."
What's next?
England need another big win when they face Papua New Guinea in their final pool match in Wollongong on Friday (9.05am). Attention will then turn to Tonga vs Samoa on Sunday (9.05am), where they require a favour from the former.
digest_he:
נבחרת אנגליה רשמה ניצחון מרשים בתוצאה 0-82 מול צרפת בפרת', תוך שהיא כובשת 14 טאצ'דאונים ושומרת לעצמה סיכויים להעפיל לחצי גמר גביע העולם ברוגבי. השחקנים הרבי פארנוורת' ודום יאנג הצטיינו עם שלושער כל אחד, בעוד שמיקי לואיס עלה מהספסל והבקיע פעמיים בניצחון שהעניק דחיפה משמעותית למאזן הנקודות של הנבחרת.

הניצחון הגיע לאחר פתיחה עצבנית והגנה צרפתית עיקשת במחצית הראשונה, אך האנגלים פרצו את הסכר בדקה ה-23 והשתלטו לחלוטין על המשחק. המאמן בריאן מקדרמוט שיבח את המאמץ הקבוצתי והמודגש של השחקנים, וציין כי הנבחרת עמדה ביעדים שהוצבו לה ללא הסחות דעת.

על מנת להבטיח את המקום בשלב הבא, אנגליה תצטרך לרשום ניצחון גבוה נוסף גם במשחק הבא מול פפואה גינאה החדשה ביום שישי, וכן לקוות לתוצאה רצויה במשחק בין טונגה לסמואה שיתקיים בהמשך השבוע.
